title: Decomposition Atlases of Brains and Kidneys from Postmortem CT: Shape and Topological Data Analysis
summary: Topological-distance clustering and seriation produce organ-specific decomposition groupings from postmortem CT; the atlas shows organ-specific ordering and only partial agreement with whole-body stages. Stage labels are approximate context, not organ-level ground truth.
ai_technology: persistent-homology distances are fused, then k-medoids clustering and seriation organize the observed organ morphologies.
